hotels.title: Contemporary Sydney Olympic Park Stay Near Accor Stadium & Qudos Bank Arena
hotels.description: Set in the heart of Sydney Olympic Park, this contemporary retreat places Accor Stadium, Qudos Bank Arena and Sydney Showground within an easy stroll. Bicentennial Park’s wetlands and walking trails are nearby, while the Aquatic Centre offers Olympic-scale pools and family-friendly facilities. Rooms are modern and compact, with many overlooking the precinct’s striking stadium architecture. For dining, Bacar serves polished modern Australian fare at nearby Pullman Sydney Olympic Park, and P’Nut Street Noodles at Sydney Olympic Park delivers fragrant Thai favourites moments away
